releases.notes:
Includes all changes and bugfixes from the latest 3 upstream NTMain updates - [X5842 - smallest NTM update](https://github.com/HbmMods/Hbm-s-Nuclear-Tech-GIT/releases/tag/1.0.27_X5842) [X5844 - the mcbroken fucking shit deluxe with extra cheese](https://github.com/HbmMods/Hbm-s-Nuclear-Tech-GIT/releases/tag/1.0.27_X5844) [X5846 - this release was brought to you by: sludgehost - enter code SLIME for 20% off](https://github.com/HbmMods/Hbm-s-Nuclear-Tech-GIT/releases/tag/1.0.27_X5846)

Bigger stuff coming later, just want this out for now so y'all can help check machines for busted ports

## Changed
* HTRF4 for the old fusion reactor has been removed
* Titanium bedrock ore on all planets changed to ilmenite, except for Tekto, which still provides pure titanium!

## Fixed
* Solar panel ports inconsistent and don't match model

## Changed
* Improved errors for station propulsion
* Saltleaf is now edible (Laythe start approaches)
* Improved Angelica shader compat (for those using Bountiful Stars)

## Fixed
* Air intake can dupe compressed air (if you need compressed air in a vacuum, you can use the air intake in a room full of any gas except compressed air)
* Titanium deco has 16 variants for no reason
* Crash on oil blob generation on celestials
* Crash when setting gas output of oil blocks to 0 in config
